# Getting Help

Before asking for help, check the documentation of the repository (its `README.md` and `docs` folder, if any) and search its existing discussions and issues.

For usage questions or general help, start a discussion in the repository, if it has discussions enabled. You can also ask in our [Discord](https://discord.gg/nomnom-762409407488720918).

When asking, include relevant details such as the version you use, the .NET SDK or operating system, a minimal code example or the steps you took, and any error messages. Remove credentials and personal or sensitive information from examples and logs.

Use the repository's issues for specific bug reports and feature requests. Keep reports focused and include steps to reproduce bugs when possible.

For suspected security vulnerabilities, do not open a public discussion or issue. Follow the private reporting instructions in the [security policy](https://github.com/zencq/.github/blob/HEAD/.github/SECURITY.md).

Please follow our [code of conduct](https://github.com/zencq/.github/blob/HEAD/.github/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) when communicating with the community.
